lines.zh: 我转着两条长臂走过来。
lines.en: I come forward swinging my two long arms.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩在糖壳上，咔咔响。
lines.en: My feet crunch on the sugar crust.
I walk and spin my arms.
My head tilts and my grin is wide.
I know every path in this candy cave.

lines.zh: 我的脚印在糖霜上黏成一串。
lines.en: My footprints stick together in a line on the frost.
I leave sticky tracks on the ground.
I turn toward the sound.
I swing my hands like I'm dancing.
I go around the syrup pool.
I walk as I please.

lines.zh: 碎糖溅到洞壁上，粘住了。
lines.en: Candy shards hit the cave wall and stick.
I stand and spin my arms.
My tongue comes out to lick my teeth.

lines.zh: 拐杖糖一举，双臂就转起来。
lines.en: Candy cane up, and my arms start spinning.
I can't stop grinning.
The smell of sugar excites me.

lines.zh: 我用长指敲着糖壳打拍子。
lines.en: I tap a rhythm on my candy shell with a long finger.
My arms are long and thin.
I hop twice on the spot.
This cave is very sweet.
I've never once been afraid.
You smell of sugar.

lines.zh: 我一边转手臂一边看你。
lines.en: I watch you while spinning my arms.
Look at my arms.

lines.zh: 我伸开手，能碰到两边墙。
lines.en: My arms can reach both walls.

lines.zh: 你站在我转得到的圈里。
lines.en: You're inside the circle I can reach.
I walk toward you backwards.
I grin widely.

lines.zh: 你退到哪儿我都够得着。
lines.en: I can reach wherever you retreat.
Close enough to smell your sweat.
I'm going to spin — watch.
I sway, still grinning.

lines.zh: 手臂甩出去，砸在岩壁上。
lines.en: My arm swings out and hits the stone wall.
My arms hang limp for a moment.
I spit out a mouthful of sugar.
I hop aside.
I grip my shoulder.
The pain only excites me more.
My arms spin up again.
My laughter bounces around the candy cavern.
I laughed that one off, but noted it.
Is this made of candy?
I toss it into my mouth.
I crunch it loudly.
The sugar needles prick my tongue, and still it is sweet.
Sweet — I like it.

lines.zh: 我的手臂一转，糖果就飞。
lines.en: One spin of my arms and candy flies.
I swing my arms wide and spin.
This little bit isn't enough.
I spin while I eat.
I've eaten it and want more.
You hit my arm.
I pushed you off.
I laugh louder.
I turned and hit you.
We stuck together a little.
I hop a step away.

lines.zh: 糖浆被我们踩得到处是。
lines.en: Between us we've tracked syrup everywhere.
There's a mark of mine on you.

lines.zh: 我的手臂一转，糖渣就飞起来。
lines.en: My arms spin and candy shards spray.
Come on, once more.
There are others in this cave.
They spin too.
We spin in a circle.
None of us looks at another.
The sweetness makes us all glad.

lines.zh: 只要甜味，就够我们转了。
lines.en: The sweetness alone is enough to keep us spinning.
The sugar frost catches me as I fall.
I fall onto the frost.
I lie there still grinning.

lines.zh: 过了一会儿我又站起来。
lines.en: After a while I get up again.
I swing it in my hand.
I hold it overhead.
I toss it into my mouth.
I chew the bones too.
I break it in two.

lines.zh: 糖渣粘在指缝里，我舍不得。
lines.en: Sugar grit clings between my fingers; I will not waste it.
This is sticky.
I throw it behind me.
I pick it up again, laughing.
I hold it while spinning.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，手臂已经开始转。
lines.en: I see you; my arms are already spinning.
I spread my hands.
My candy shell clicks at the joints.
My arms reach both sides.

lines.zh: 两条手臂把两条路都封了。
lines.en: My two arms close off both paths.

lines.zh: 拐杖糖爪子划出一道弧。
lines.en: My candy cane claws trace an arc.
Every path here is mine.

lines.zh: 我两条长臂转起来，糖壳咔咔响。
lines.en: My two long arms spin, sugar shell crunching.
Here I come — don't move.
You've backed to the syrup.
I hop once.
I'm going to pounce.

lines.zh: 拐杖糖做的爪子，转一圈。
lines.en: Candy-cane claws spin a full circle.
My grin stretches ear to ear.
Both hands reach out.
I spin, and sugar shards fly.
I spin my arms and press in.
You go left; my left hand gets there first.
I pounce from above.
I can jump very high.
I claw my way up the sugar pillar.
The sugar crust cracks when I land.
I spin once more.
Your sweat is mixed into the sweetness.
Syrup bubbles behind your feet.

lines.zh: 抬头，我从糖果堆上扑下来。
lines.en: Look up, I am leaping off the candy pile.
My long arms span wider than the passage.
Now you can't dodge.
I counted twice, then moved.
The sugar cave's sweetness drives me wild.
I'm coming down.
I know where you are.
I take one long step in.
My fingers sweep past, trailing sugar grit.
My fingers touched you.
Good — stay right there.
I swing my spinning arms into you.
I bring both hands down.
The sweep throws you far back.
I slam down from above.
My fingers rake your shoulder.
My arms sweep through empty air.

lines.zh: 我摔在糖霜上，又爬起来。
lines.en: I fall on the frost and get up again.
I'm laughing too hard to breathe.
My sugar is stuck to you.
I'm spinning again.
I press a dent into the sugar frost.
You slipped out of my hands.
I spin away.
The ground is covered in broken candy.

lines.zh: 两臂一起转成一片影子。
lines.en: Both arms spin into a blur.
This time I'm faster.
You've backed to the pool.

lines.zh: 这次我撞碎了半根糖柱。
lines.en: This time I smash half a sugar pillar.
I spin my arms and icing flies.
I sweep you away.
I step out from behind a candy column.
My arms show first.
I spin in circles, grinning.
The sweetness here sets me going.
My prints stay in the frost.

lines.zh: 洞顶的糖晶在我头顶响。
lines.en: The sugar crystals overhead chime above me.
Sugar crystals hang from the ceiling.
I can already smell a person.
I head that way.
I skip as I walk.

lines.zh: 我笑得整个洞都听得见。
lines.en: My laughing carries through the cave.
I try one spin first.

lines.zh: 火把我身上的糖烤成了硬壳。
lines.en: Fire bakes the sugar on me into a shell.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，糖壳碎了一地。
lines.en: I land from a height and the crust shatters.

lines.zh: 糖浆把我裹住，我挣扎着。
lines.en: Syrup closes over me and I thrash.
The blast throws me into a candy column.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的手臂，我笑不出来。
lines.en: An arrow pins my arm, and I stop laughing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的手臂转不动。
lines.en: That light stops my arms from turning.
Hungry, and I want sweets even more.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身抖了一阵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body shakes.
No sugar underfoot, only emptiness.
